property_summary: For any Put(_unlockTime) call, the stored unlockTime for that account must equal _unlockTime when _unlockTime > block.timestamp (otherwise block.timestamp), so a fuzzed _unlockTime in the future must be reflected in Acc(actor).unlockTime, which the mutant leaves at zero.
change_summary: Delete the initialization of acc.unlockTime so Put does not update unlockTime.
